title: lig50K recon - Tube based
body:
### 1. lig50K nucleosome recon (tube-based)

| Step | Event | Buffer added | Total volume | Monovalent salt | Proposed hold |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | Dissolve dried salt completely in 5 µL DNA | — | 5.000 µL | ~2.00 M | Until dissolved |
| 2 | Add 1.2 µL working octamer; mix gently | — | **6.200 µL** | **1.806 M** | 30 min |
| 3 | Gradually add buffer and mix gently | **1.27 µL** | 7.467 µL | 1.500 M | 60 min |
| 4 | Continue dilution | **3.733 µL** | 11.200 µL | 1.000 M | 60 min |
| 5 | Continue dilution | **2.800 µL** | 14.000 µL | 0.800 M | 60 min |
| 6 | Continue dilution | **4.667 µL** | 18.667 µL | 0.600 M | 60 min |
| 7 | Continue dilution | **9.333 µL** | 28.000 µL | 0.400 M | 60 min |
| 8 | Reach primary endpoint | **16.800 µL** | **44.800 µL** | **0.250 M** | 60 min |
| Optional | Dilute further | **11.200 µL** | **56.000 µL** | **0.200 M** | 60 min |
